a: configKey writes every Map and every Set as `{}`, so configs differing only inside one share a key
isPortSafe passes a Date, RegExp, ArrayBuffer or typed array whole, own expando properties included, which a port drops
useArgs sends an update to a forge-reserved key over the port, where the shell drops it, and keeps no local copy
b: A leaf's `default` crosses the port unsanitized, though its annotations are stripped to data
An arg cleared or set to a frame-local value through `useArgs` still reads as its config value to `argTypes.if`
`play` gets args without the frame-local ones, which its render sees
`if: { eq: undefined }` is tested as an equality, where Storybook ignores it
